title: Crème Brûlée
desc: Low-key, moody directional light cuts through the atmospheric gloom of a midnight speakeasy, grazing a dark, hand-crafted stoneware platter resting on a weathered stone counter. At its center, rustic portions of crème brûlée reveal fractured, glassy amber crusts yielding to dense vanilla bean custard, while glistening forest berries catch brilliant highlights in the deep shadows.
